items.title: Vertiv vs Schneider Electric. Only One AI Cooling Stock Deserves Your Money
items.summary: Vertiv and Schneider Electric both posted blockbuster AI-driven growth, but their earnings tell two very different stories about where the real money gets made in the data center cooling race.

items.title: Vertiv Is Putting $1.45 Billion Down for AI Power. Nearly Half the Price Is Contingent.
items.summary: Whether the data center infrastructure supplier pays the full $2.6 billion is up to the company it's buying.

items.title: Why Vertiv (VRT) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of data center products and services company Vertiv (NYSE:VRT) jumped 4.6% in the afternoon session after the stock continued to rally as the company announced an agreement to acquire UtilityInnovation Group for approximately $1.45 billion in cash at closing to accelerate power deployment for AI data centers.

items.title: Is This Pullback In Vertiv Stock A Glitch Or A Warning?
items.summary: The data center infrastructure provider is growing fast, but its stock just hit a rough patch, leaving investors to weigh a powerful history against a pricey present.

items.title: Teradyne Stock Plunges 15% in a Month: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.summary: TER stock lost 15.4% in a month, but strong AI data-center demand, UltraFLEXplus growth, and positive third-quarter guidance support its outlook.

items.title: Can VRT's UIG Deal Deepen Its AI Power Edge Over APH & SMCI?
items.summary: Vertiv's $1.45B UIG deal adds microgrid and behind-the-meter power capabilities, broadening its AI data-center infrastructure push.

items.title: Trump Warned Towns They’d End Up Poor Without Data Centers but Berkshire’s CEO Sees a Revolt Growing
items.summary: A White House AI adviser is selling data centers as economic lifelines while Berkshire's Greg Abel warns of a full-blown revolt taking shape in communities across the country. One of them is reading a very different map of where a trillion dollars in AI spending actually lands.

items.title: Vertiv Stock Keeps Cooling Off. One Analyst Says a 100% Rally Is Coming
items.summary: Vertiv has quietly shed nearly a third of its value from its peak even as earnings beats pile up and estimates keep climbing higher. One analyst has a target so far above current prices it sounds almost absurd, but the operating data behind it is harder to dismiss than you might expect.
